title: 第十八章 折雪诀第十九章 羁绊
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
“好，稍后我陪你去青莲峰看看。”身后传来司楚白低声的回应。
“楚白师兄，”千沐妍的声音又轻轻响起，带着几分小心翼翼的试探，“你说，我今年有望突破金丹中期吗？”
此话一出，走在前方的谢清猗心思微动，千沐妍年方二十一，如今堪堪金丹初期的境界尚未稳固，此时忽然问及金丹中期……
她想起原著中，原身正是在二十一岁那年一举突破至金丹中期。原来，千沐妍竟是在这儿与她较着劲呢，连破境时机都要争个输赢，女主还真是无聊。
谢清猗步履未停，身后的话语不停缠绕在她耳际，让人烦不胜烦。
“修行之道，贵在循序渐进。”司楚白的嗓音自身后传来：“根基若不牢靠，纵然一时进境迅猛，恐将来元婴难成。”
“师兄教诲的是，”千沐妍立即柔声应道，“沐妍记下了。”
谢清猗眸中闪过一丝了然，千沐妍本想借机与她较劲，又想表现自己，却不料这番心思白费，还被司楚白训诫了一番修行要义。
她终是没忍住，唇角无声地扬起一抹清浅的弧度，忽然觉得，这春日微风，似乎也格外沁人心脾了些。
谢清猗不欲再给千沐妍任何借题发挥的余地，索性提快步伐，衣袂生风地走在了最前头。
奈何身后那娇柔嗓音如影随形，伴着司楚白时不时的温声应答，依旧绵绵不绝地追着她。
好在这段路不算太长，转过最后的玉阶，一座高耸入云的楼阁便映入眼帘，匾额上’珍宝阁’三个古篆字流转着淡淡的金色光晕。
只见面容清癯的宋执事正静立在珍宝阁前的玉阶上，颧骨如刀削般分明，更衬得神色肃穆。
门前零星散着几位内门弟子，原本聚在一处低声交谈，见到来人后立即整了整衣冠，纷纷上前恭敬作揖。
一时间“师叔”的见礼声此起彼伏，在晨光中连成一片。
司楚白稳步上前，向宋执事拱手一礼：“有劳宋执事，我等特来领取此次前往句余山秘境所需的丹药与符箓。”
宋执事原本肃穆的面容，在看见来人是司楚白后，顿时如春风化雪，连声道：“好！好！这就为诸位准备。”
等候间隙，千沐妍的目光在谢清猗身上流转片刻，忽然绽开一个笑容：“此次秘境之行......”她顿了顿，眼风不经意地扫过前方的司楚白，语气婉转，“我听师尊提及，句余山有两处入口，需分作两队进入。不知谢师姐作何打算？”
谢清猗眼底漾开一丝几不可察的流光，不必这般迂回试探，她都明白，对于千沐妍那点心思只觉得有些好笑。不过，这倒是正中下怀，她本就不愿与他们同行，如此正好各走各路。
既然千沐妍已将她视作情敌，不如趁早表明立场。她心念一转，想起原主与顾怀瑾，沈江寒二人素有交情，明日或可邀他们同行。

思及此，她面上浮现一抹浅笑：“我金丹中期，与顾师兄，沈师兄同行最为相宜。他们二人皆是元婴中期，足以照应。卫师弟定然要追随司师兄，至于百里师兄与姜师兄，一位初入元婴，一位金丹大圆满，但凭司师兄安排便是。”
司楚白不知何时已走近，那些对话显然尽数落入他耳中。
他平静的面容上极快地闪过一丝讶异，眼睫微微一颤，旋即恢复成一贯的温和，缓声道：“谢师妹虽已至金丹中期，但秘境之中变数丛生，还是随我同行更为稳妥。”
谢清猗听得太阳穴突突直跳，身体不由得后退一步，她又不是原主，更无意攀附，这位男主莫非看不出她的刻意疏离？大哥，求放过啊！
千沐妍见司楚白竟出言挽留，眸中微光一闪，急忙附和：“楚白师兄，刚才谢师姐所言极是，如此安排最为妥当，可将百里师兄或是姜师兄分来我们这队，有你在便万无一失了。”
谢清猗见情势微妙，担心千沐妍再多言，反生枝节，若届时司楚白再度拒绝，反倒令三人处境尴尬。她羽睫轻垂，不去看对方，柔声道：“既然如此，分队之事，不若等到明日，再与众位师兄一同商议，更为周全些。”
与他们分别时，谢清猗见司楚白的目光在她身上停留了片刻，那眼神里似乎藏着几分欲言又止，连带着那双总是清朗的眸子里，也染上了一抹黯淡。他终究什么也没说，只微微一颔首，便转身离去。
content_en:
"Okay, I'll accompany you to Qinglian Peak later." Si Chubai responded in a low voice from behind.
"Senior Brother Chu Bai," Qian Muyan's voice sounded softly again, with a hint of cautious probing, "Do you think I am expected to break through to the middle stage of the Golden Core this year?"
As soon as these words came out, Xie Qingyi, who was walking in front, thought slightly. Qian Muyan was only twenty-one years old, and now the realm of the early stage of the golden elixir had not yet been stabilized. At this time, he suddenly asked about the middle stage of the golden elixir...
She remembered that in the original work, the original person broke through to the middle stage of Jindan at the age of twenty-one. It turns out that Qian Muyan is actually competing with her here. She even has to fight for the opportunity to break through. The heroine is really boring.
Xie Qingyi didn't stop walking, and the words behind her kept lingering in her ears, which was annoying.
"The way to practice is to proceed step by step." Si Chubai's voice came from behind: "If the foundation is not solid, even if the progress is rapid at the moment, it may be difficult to achieve Nascent Soul in the future."
"That's what senior brother taught me," Qian Muyan immediately responded softly, "Mu Yan took note of it."
A flash of understanding flashed in Xie Qingyi's eyes. Qian Muyan wanted to take the opportunity to compete with her and express herself, but unexpectedly, her efforts were in vain and she was lectured by Si Chubai on the essentials of cultivation.
She finally couldn't hold it back, and the corners of her lips silently raised a slight arc. Suddenly, she felt that the spring breeze seemed to be particularly refreshing.
Xie Qingyi didn't want to give Qian Muyan any room to make excuses, so he simply picked up the pace and walked at the front in his smocked clothes.
However, the soft voice behind her followed her like a shadow, accompanying Si Chubai's warm responses from time to time, still chasing her endlessly.
Fortunately, this section of the road is not too long. After turning the last jade steps, a towering pavilion comes into view. The three ancient seal characters "Zhenbao Pavilion" on the plaque are flowing with a faint golden halo.
I saw the pale-faced Deacon Song standing quietly on the jade steps in front of the Zhenbao Pavilion. His cheekbones were as sharp as a knife, which made his expression even more solemn.
There were a few inner disciples scattered in front of the door. They were originally gathered together and chatting in low voices. When they saw the visitor, they immediately straightened their clothes and came forward to bow respectfully.
For a while, the greetings of "Uncle Master" came one after another, and they merged into one in the morning light.
Si Chubai stepped forward steadily and bowed to Deacon Song: "Thank you, Deacon Song. We are here to collect the elixirs and talismans needed for this trip to the secret realm of Juyu Mountain."
Deacon Song's originally solemn face suddenly turned like spring breeze into snow when he saw that the person coming was Si Chubai, and he said repeatedly: "Okay! Okay! I'll prepare it for you all."
While waiting, Qian Muyan's eyes wandered over Xie Qingyi for a moment, and she suddenly broke out into a smile: "This trip to the secret realm..." She paused, her eyes casually glanced at Si Chubai in front of her, and her tone was gentle, "I heard Master mentioned that there are two entrances to Juyu Mountain, and they need to be divided into two teams to enter. I wonder what Senior Sister Xie's plans are?"
There was an almost imperceptible glimmer in Xie Qingyi's eyes. She didn't need to be so roundabout and probing, she understood that Qian Muyan's thoughts were only a little funny. However, this was exactly what she wanted. She didn't want to go with them, so they just went their separate ways.
Since Qian Muyan has regarded her as a love rival, it is better to express her position as soon as possible. She thought about it and remembered that the original owner had a good relationship with Gu Huaijin and Shen Jianghan, and she might invite them to go with her tomorrow.
Thinking of this, a faint smile appeared on her face: "As I am in the middle stage of the Golden Core, it is most suitable for me to go with Senior Brother Gu and Senior Brother Shen. Both of them are in the middle stage of the Nascent Soul, which is enough to take care of them. Junior Brother Wei will definitely follow Senior Brother Si. As for Senior Brother Baili and Senior Brother Jiang, one has just entered the Nascent Soul and the other has reached the Great Perfection of the Golden Core. But it depends on the arrangements of Senior Brother Si."
Si Chubai came closer at some point, and it was obvious that all those conversations fell into his ears.
A trace of surprise flashed across his calm face very quickly, his eyelashes trembled slightly, and then he returned to his usual gentleness, and said slowly: "Although Junior Sister Xie has reached the middle stage of the Golden Core, there are many variables in the secret realm.Students, it is safer to go with me. "
Xie Qingyi felt his temples twitching, and he couldn't help but take a step back. She was not the original owner, and she had no intention of clinging to her. Could it be that the male protagonist couldn't see her deliberate alienation? Brother, please let me go!
When Qian Muyan saw that Si Chubai actually tried to persuade him to stay, a glimmer of light flashed in her eyes, and she hurriedly agreed: "Senior Brother Chu Bai, what Senior Sister Xie said just now is absolutely true. This arrangement is the most appropriate. If Senior Brother Baili or Senior Brother Jiang are assigned to our team, everything will be safe with you here. "
Seeing that the situation was delicate, Xie Qingyi was worried that if Qian Muyan said more, it would lead to complications. If Si Chubai refused again, it would put the three of them in an embarrassing situation. She lowered her eyelashes lightly, not looking at the other party, and said softly: "In this case, it would be more thorough to wait until tomorrow to discuss the matter of detachment with all the senior brothers. "
When they parted ways, Xie Qingyi saw Si Chubai's eyes lingering on her for a moment. There seemed to be a hint of hesitation in his eyes, and his always clear eyes were also stained with a touch of gloom. After all, he didn't say anything, just nodded slightly, then turned and left.
